第十四章【你信我不是坏人】
刚刚年满18岁，今年正在上大一的陆思思，已经快哭出来了。
本来么，今天下午学校没课，她跑来这里溜达，刚才在二楼的小吃店吃着东西，坐在临窗的位置，就拿出手机来拍拍街景。
结果，手一滑……下面一声惨叫，然后就一堆人围上来开骂。
知道闯祸了的女孩，赶紧一溜烟跑下来，可迎面就看见了路边站着那个在飞机上揍了自己一拳的家伙。
弄得陆思思现在都不知道自己是该紧张，该焦急，还是该害怕了。
是的，害怕。
虽然前几天在机场处理事情的时候，陈言声称自己是认错了人。
但陆思思却总感觉不对——不知道为什么，她总觉得，这个家伙并不是认错了人。
她总怀疑，这个男人是故意找的自己，故意认准自己揍的那一拳。
没什么证据，就是一种莫名其妙的感觉。
陆思思显得很慌乱，结结巴巴的向小赵道歉，拼命解释自己不是故意的，慌里慌张的说自己是如何在窗户边用手机拍风景，如何手一滑……
然后女孩就眼睛红红的表示自己愿意赔偿。

不过看见摔在地上已经死的不能再死的手机，女孩傻眼了。
没手机，自己想赔钱都没法赔。
眼看着这姑娘态度这么好，说着说着都快掉眼泪了——跟着小赵的学生们渐渐都没了声讨的声音。
态度好是一条，更重要的是……人家妹子看着清清秀秀萌萌哒，一副我见犹怜的样子嘛。
谁还不是个颜狗了？
小赵也立刻大声表示自己没事儿，还反过来安慰人家妹子不要太害怕，自己不是坏人，更不会讹人……
看小赵那个样子，恨不能当场表演个俯卧撑，来表示自己无恙。
看着小赵那个便宜的样子，陈言心中叹了口气，不过还是上去道：“要不，还是去医院看看？万一你砸出个脑震荡什么的呢？”
“对，对，去医院看一下也好。”
，陆思思也点头赶紧表态。
陈言记得，在机场的时候，这个妹子大度的谅解了自己，没有趁机狮子大张口，心肠不坏的。
“不用去医院了，这点小伤，我回头弄个创口贴拍上就好了。”
，小赵依然贱兮兮的笑着：“这样吧，你给我留个电话号码，万一有事我再找你。”
陈言看了小赵一眼，这心思都快写在脸上了吧？
陈言不动声色，在后面轻轻的踢了一下小赵的脚后跟：“还是去下医院吧，我记得一条街外就有个小医院的，地方不远，去看看也放心。”
“啊？”
小赵有点不明所以，却察觉到陈言对着自己，眼神很认真，同时很细微的点了一下头。
他和陈言交情很好，历来很信任陈言，此刻虽然还有些不明白，但却也不出言反对了。
陈言望了一眼陆思思：“你跟着一起去医院，这个要求不过分吧？”

Chapter 14 [Do you believe I’m not a bad person]
Lu Sisi, who had just turned 18 and was a freshman this year, was almost crying.
Originally, there were no classes in school this afternoon, so she came here for a walk. She was eating at the snack bar on the second floor. She sat near the window and took out her mobile phone to take pictures of the street scene.
As a result, his hand slipped... There was a scream from below, and then a bunch of people gathered around and started to curse.
Knowing that she was in trouble, the girl quickly ran down, but she saw the guy who punched her on the plane standing on the side of the road.
Lu Sisi didn't know whether she should be nervous, anxious, or afraid.
Yes, afraid.
Although when handling things at the airport a few days ago, Chen Yan claimed that he had mistakenly admitted the wrong person.
But Lu Sisi always felt something was wrong - for some reason, she always felt that this guy didn't recognize the wrong person.
She always suspected that this man was looking for her on purpose and aimed the punch at her.
There is no evidence, just an inexplicable feeling.
Lu Sisi looked very flustered. She stammered an apology to Xiao Zhao and tried her best to explain that she didn't mean it. She panicked and talked about how she was taking pictures of the scenery with her mobile phone by the window and how her hand slipped...
Then the girl expressed her willingness to compensate with red eyes.
But when she saw the dead cell phone that fell to the ground, the girl was dumbfounded.
Without a mobile phone, I can’t even lose money if I want to.
Seeing that this girl had such a good attitude, she almost shed tears as she spoke - and the students who followed Xiao Zhao gradually stopped making any sound of condemnation.
She has a good attitude, but more importantly... the girl looks so delicate and cute, and I feel pity for her.
Who isn’t a pretty guy anymore?
Xiao Zhao also immediately loudly expressed that he was fine, and in turn comforted the girl not to be too afraid. He was not a bad person, and he would not blackmail anyone...
Looking at Xiao Zhao's appearance, I wished I could perform push-ups on the spot to show that I was fine.
Seeing Xiao Zhao's cheap look, Chen Yan sighed in his heart, but still went up and said, "How about going to the hospital? What if you get a concussion or something?"
"Yes, yes, you might as well go to the hospital for a checkup."
, Lu Sisi also nodded and quickly expressed her stance.
Chen Yan remembered that when he was at the airport, this girl generously forgave him and did not take advantage of the opportunity to open her mouth. She was not a bad person.
"There's no need to go to the hospital. This is a minor injury. I'll just get a band-aid and put it on."
, Xiao Zhao still smiled mischievously: "Well, just leave me your phone number and I'll call you if anything happens."
Chen Yan glanced at Xiao Zhao, his thoughts were almost written on his face, right?
Chen Yan remained calm and gently kicked Xiao Zhao's heel from behind: "It's better to go to the hospital. I remember there is a small hospital just a street away. It's not far away. It's safe to go and have a look."
"Huh?"
Xiao Zhao was a little confused, but he noticed that Chen Yan was looking at him seriously and nodded slightly at the same time.
He has a good relationship with Chen Yan and has always trusted Chen Yan. Although he still doesn't understand it at the moment, he doesn't object.
Chen Yan glanced at Lu Sisi and said, "You go with me to the hospital. Isn't this too much to ask for?"
